05 / Provenance

Keep the trail visible.

This edition reconciles Google Drive design records with current GitHub documentation and source, inspected October 8, 2026.

What the labels mean

Visual studies

Existing artwork demonstrates a direction. It does not establish a complete set of card faces.

Documented design

Card text, court assignments or a visual brief exists. Production and playtesting are separate milestones.

Engine source

Implementation was found in a repository. A working public service requires separate deployment evidence.

Where the records disagree

Clubs court and missing pip cards

An older Dueling Systems handoff calls the base Clubs royals and pips 3–9 missing. The August Court Card Bible supplies Ptah, Seshat and Imhotep; the full card database and reference PDF include Clubs 3–9. The catalogue uses those records and keeps the discrepancy visible.

Court lore and universal face-card powers

The court bible associates mythic characters with named powers. The legacy mechanical database uses universal J, Q, K and A rules across every suit. These layers have not been merged into a new ruleset here.

Deck history and current Veiled Dominion canon

The current four-player, 14×14 GDD and rulebook govern canonical mechanics. The older dice/card/chess system, cultural reskins and Duet experiments do not change that authority.

Bot source, older plans and current availability

The older Rift document says event posting was live. Current Duet documentation leaves live configuration and successful posts unverified. The October 4 Roomy transition records both identified Discord services shut down, while browser reuse is proposed.

Artwork, interpretation and publication

The three PIXIE images are existing AI-generated concept studies. Text specimens throughout the collection display recorded card information; they are not newly discovered illustrations. Cultural editions present authored creative interpretations. Third-party character references do not imply affiliation or merchandise permission.

The design archive

Drive records inspected include the Sealed Deck Court Card Bible, Global Mythological Skins, Sufi Tariqah, design requirements, Systems Quartet, Inpatient Corridors, the visual-variant briefs, Violet_88 proposal, Rift engagement plan, Paragon workbook, Deck Design Notes, Queen’s Journey and the Space/Aether exploration.

The catalogue publishes relevant design summaries. Raw private documents, invitation details and operational credentials are not part of the public site.

Original hero-card direction

The current source is the merged original hero-card design, with its content admission and provenance requirements. The earlier Paragon assignment list is historical research. The receiving experiment contract remains draft. Status checked October 8, 2026, America/Chicago.

Research reference: Phuture Me

Our assessment: useful for studying deck selection, symbolic relationships and optional interpretation. Its app advertises custom decks and spreads through Pro tools, with saved-reading export. This suggests a possible manual authoring trial for original hero-story cards or PIXIE prompts; custom card limits, file compatibility and iPad accessibility still require hands-on verification.

Use original authored situations and player choices for our game. Numerology is creative vocabulary, not evidence of combat balance. No Phuture Me API integration, asset license or automated adapter is established here.

Its AI service sends reading content to third-party processors. Use fictional test material if evaluating it. Its terms describe entertainment services for adults and restrict reproduction of site materials. We have copied no deck artwork or interpretation text.
